title: Hold a licence to handle explosives
what: Manufacture explosives only under a manufacturing licence, store licensable quantities only under a storage licence, and carry them by road only under a carrying licence (or an interstate authority).

sources.title: Dangerous Substances (Explosives) Regulation 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: reg 48 (current republication (R32, from 16 December 2025; Dangerous Substances (Explosives) Regulation 2004 | Subordinate laws))
sources.quote: A person is authorised to manufacture an explosive if the person— (a) holds a manufacturing licence authorising the manufacture of the explosive

sources.title: Dangerous Substances (Explosives) Regulation 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: reg 125(1) (current republication (R32, from 16 December 2025; Dangerous Substances (Explosives) Regulation 2004 | Subordinate laws))
sources.quote: A person must not store an explosive unless— (a) for a licensable quantity of the explosive—the person is authorised under a storage licence to store the explosive

sources.title: Dangerous Substances (Explosives) Regulation 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: reg 100(1) (current republication (R32, from 16 December 2025; Dangerous Substances (Explosives) Regulation 2004 | Subordinate laws))
sources.quote: A person must not carry an explosive by road (in the ACT) unless— (a) the person is authorised to carry the explosive by road (in the ACT) under a carrying licence

sources.title: Dangerous Substances Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 52, words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current republication (R56, from 16 December 2025; Dangerous Substances Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: The work health and safety commissioner must issue the licence to the person if satisfied that— (a) the person is a suitable person to hold the licence

reach.condition: if it makes, stores or carries explosives
